title: Director of Marketing

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: Mimaki's active presence at ISA Sign Expo and PRINTING United Expo, coupled with their recent facility expansion and 25-year anniversary messaging, indicates aggressive go-to-market activity. The Director of Marketing owns messaging around product durability, competitive positioning, and customer-facing value propositions. Tedlar enables powerful marketing claims: '20+ year outdoor graphics protection,' 'graffiti-proof vehicle wraps,' and 'maintenance-free architectural graphics.' With Mimaki's customers in vehicle wraps, outdoor signage, and architectural graphics facing constant durability complaints and warranty issues, partnering with Tedlar gives Marketing concrete proof points for trade show messaging, sales collateral, and customer success stories. This role is measured on market share growth, brand perception, and lead generation—all improved by positioning Mimaki as the durability leader. The recent expansion into Flowery Branch with an enlarged showroom suggests they're investing heavily in customer experience, making Tedlar demonstrations and durability testing natural showroom content that drives conversions.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: The Director of Marketing at Mimaki USA owns competitive messaging, product positioning, and go-to-market campaigns across Mimaki's wide-format printer portfolio. This role manages trade show presence (ISA, PRINTING United), develops sales collateral emphasizing durability and outdoor performance, and drives customer-facing content for dealer enablement and end-user education. They influence product bundling recommendations, accessory partnerships, and warranty messaging. They report to executive leadership (likely CMO or VP Commercial) and collaborate closely with Product Development and Sales. Their team likely includes brand managers, digital marketing specialists, and trade show coordinators. They don't own technical specifications but control how those specs translate into market-facing value propositions.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Three Tedlar use cases directly support Mimaki's marketing agenda: (1) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics—Tedlar's graffiti resistance and UV protection enable marketing claims about maintenance-free wraps that withstand vandalism and weather extremes, reducing customer callbacks and warranty disputes; (2) Outdoor signage and architectural graphics—Tedlar's 12-20+ year lifespan provides quantifiable differentiation versus competitors' 3-5 year overlaminate solutions, giving Mimaki's JV200 Series and eco-solvent printers a premium positioning story; (3) Trade show demonstrations—Tedlar's graffiti resistance (spray paint wipes clean) creates compelling live demos for Mimaki's expanded Flowery Branch showroom and ISA/PRINTING United booths, turning product features into experiential proof points. These use cases directly address Mimaki's current messaging around 'industry's best outdoor color durability' and partnership with 3M's MCS Warranty Program by offering superior protection that extends graphic lifespan and reduces end-user maintenance costs.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This role is measured on brand differentiation metrics (competitive win rates, premium pricing maintenance), marketing-qualified lead generation from trade shows and digital campaigns, and dealer/channel satisfaction with marketing support materials. They personally care about creating defensible claims that sales teams can use to justify Mimaki's premium pricing against lower-cost Asian competitors. With Mimaki celebrating 25 years in the Americas and opening a new expanded facility, the Director of Marketing is under pressure to drive growth through market share expansion and premium positioning. Warranty claims and customer complaints about graphic durability undermine marketing promises and create negative word-of-mouth—Tedlar solves this by turning durability from a claim into a provable advantage. Additionally, this role needs fresh content for the new Flowery Branch showroom and upcoming 2026 trade show calendar; Tedlar demonstrations and customer success stories provide ready-made content that drives booth traffic and dealer engagement.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Mimaki exhibited at ISA 2026 in Orlando (April 2026) and has consistent presence at PRINTING United Expo, indicating active trade show planning cycles. The June 2025 opening of their expanded Flowery Branch, GA facility with enlarged showroom creates immediate opportunity for Tedlar demonstration stations and customer experience content. Mimaki's recent Pinnacle Award win for their JFX200-1213 EX printer and ongoing promotion of the JV200 Series' outdoor durability suggests they're actively promoting outdoor performance messaging—making NOW the ideal time to introduce Tedlar as the protective film that validates these claims. The 25-year anniversary messaging and facility expansion signal investment in brand elevation, not cost-cutting, creating receptivity to premium solutions that strengthen competitive differentiation.

personalization_hooks.hook: Mimaki's new Flowery Branch showroom and expanded customer experience facility needs demonstration content that proves outdoor durability claims
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their recent facility investment and suggest Tedlar graffiti-resistance demonstrations as a showroom centerpiece that turns technical specs into visual proof—this gives them experiential content that differentiates dealer visits and supports their premium positioning

personalization_hooks.hook: Mimaki's partnership with 3M MCS Warranty Program and emphasis on 'industry's best outdoor color durability' positions them for premium messaging, but they need third-party validation that extends beyond ink chemistry
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as the protective layer that completes Mimaki's durability story—their printers produce the graphics, Tedlar ensures those graphics last 20+ years outdoors, creating a total system approach that competitors can't match and giving Marketing a concrete ROI story for vehicle wrap and signage customers

personalization_hooks.hook: Director of Marketing owns trade show messaging and dealer enablement for ISA and PRINTING United events where outdoor durability and TCO are primary customer concerns
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame outreach around upcoming trade show calendar—offer to co-develop booth messaging or case studies showing Tedlar-protected graphics withstanding graffiti and UV exposure, giving them differentiated content that drives booth traffic and supports post-show sales follow-up with durability-focused prospects

recommended_approach: Lead with the new showroom opportunity and trade show calendar as conversation starters, then pivot to how Tedlar enables Mimaki's existing durability messaging. Emphasize that this isn't asking them to change their positioning—it's offering a solution that validates and strengthens their current claims about outdoor performance. Frame Tedlar as a marketing asset (proof points, demos, case studies) rather than just a product partnership, aligning with their role as a messaging and brand owner rather than technical decision-maker.
